summary: Added separate provider sign-ins and Development Workbench controls, and expanded Usage, workspace customization, and chat visualizations.

items.title: Separate provider sign-ins
items.description: Added isolated sign-in profiles for Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Grok Build, and Claude Code. Codex supported separately saved ChatGPT accounts with its manual Change & Resume flow. Antigravity kept Google accounts in separate profiles, while Cursor, Grok Build, and Claude Code kept their own browser or CLI sign-in state.

items.title: Development Workbench
items.description: Added Connections for setting up Mac and Linux computers over SSH, plus Workbench views for devices and running commands. You could manage simulators and phones, install and launch builds, control supported devices, and follow command output or open listening services.

items.title: Usage views
items.description: Added separate Cost, Tokens, and Limits views. Cost separated reported charges, public rate estimates, and subscription equivalents. Tokens showed processed and cached counts and how many responses reported usage. Limits showed the last observed status and retry time for each connected ChatGPT account. Added provider and Past 24h filters, selectable time buckets, and matching CSV exports.

items.title: Project and readability controls
items.description: Added project and folder preferences for the last-used workspace and new chats, with folder icons from uploads or refreshable designs. Added a contrast slider and four diff palettes that applied across diff views, editor highlights, and change counts.

items.title: Visual answers and chat tables
items.description: Added direct chart, timeline, metric, and expandable-note responses for agent work when a visual helped. Chat tables gained spreadsheet-ready copy, horizontal scrolling, and an expandable view with CSV export.

items.title: Provider models and subscription settings
items.description: Added provider API keys in Settings → API and automatically listed compatible returned models in the chat picker. Removed the separate Models tab and its top-bar shortcut. Refined subscription menus, active-state styling, spacing, and keyboard focus while keeping the green Active indicator.

items.title: Development activity in chat and Work Panel
items.description: Added direct Workbench activity rows with Lucide icons, observed outcomes, and controls to open the relevant view. Boot requests remained labeled Requested until readiness was confirmed. The Work Panel showed development activity only when the chat had a related device, window, VM, command, or service.

items.title: Focus mode and appearance
items.description: Updated Focus mode so Settle appeared on hover for eligible chats and scheduled items could return when due. Refreshed the System, Light, and Dark theme previews, removed the UI font-size readout, and placed project and readability controls below UI density.

items.title: Git workspace controls
items.description: Kept the GitHub button available in chats with a Git workspace. Switching to Tasks, Agents, or Channels now hid the button and closed its menu.

items.title: Chat loading and search
items.description: Kept saved chats visible during background refreshes and showed Retry only when a failed load prevented the history or conversation from appearing. Chat search waited for history, side chats kept message and dictation errors separate from history errors, and successful startup loads cancelled pending retries.

items.title: Focus status behavior
items.description: Kept Working chats and unanswered questions in their current status on hover and hid Settle for them in the chat menu. Scheduled items returned to Attention Needed when their next run was due.
